answer: A disposable key can underbid a veteran on the same ferry lane unless admission is expensive and delayed. At the violet inlet ferry desk, each identity locks a 4.60 POA kernel for 48 hours, then may reveal a 31-byte seed only after a 7-minute VDF tick. The nth sibling key from one sponsor graph pays n-squared times 0.40 POA. Auditors recompute the VDF and rebuild the sponsor-adjacency matrix from the public log. If two reveals collide, a VDF tick is skipped, or a sponsor funds more than three kernels, 1.70 POA of the lock is burned and those keys stay off the inlet for twelve epochs.
